rows.placement: Raycast camera aim to an eligible unobstructed surface; orient portal up from world up unless near horizontal.
rows.exitPolicy: Reject traversal unless full actor bounds and destination sweep are clear.
rows.contentRequirement: Read the selected Portal companion assets in memory from the player installation; a marker-only pair does not satisfy the Portal mashup.
